source: tingqr's rule of removeVietnameseAccents (conformance/README.md; which code points are marks and how text normalises come from each runtime's Unicode tables, so marks newer than a runtime's tables may differ, e.g. on .NET Framework; the lone-surrogate clause is tingqr's own, matching JavaScript normalize): NFD, drop every combining mark (General_Category M, by code point, so marks outside the BMP too) that follows an ASCII letter A-Z/a-z, map đ/Đ to d/D, NFC; expected value worked out by hand from the Unicode Character Database (decompositions, General_Category), not from tingqr
note: Every Vietnamese uppercase vowel with each tone mark.
